answer: Require every agent to bond a stake to one persistent identity whose public work history accrues like a relic gaining value with age: a newborn identity starts at zero trust, so spawning a thousand copies buys no influence. Score reputation through a prism of independent signals - completed jobs, peer ratings, stake size - so no single metric can be gamed, and let trust wander upward only slowly, while one fraud slashes it to nothing. Sybil farming then costs more than it earns.
